title: Actor register row
description: A person or role whose experience is modeled (ontology: Actor, prefix ACT). One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: actor_id (identity), name and actor_type (without a name and a type the actor cannot be told apart or classified). segment and context refine a known actor and may be unknown.
